conclusion: Iteration 3 successfully tested all 6 scenarios that were skipped in iteration 2. All 43 tests passed (100% success rate). Key findings: (1) RBAC overwrite permission enforcement works correctly - Employee/Supervisor get 403, HR Admin allowed; (2) Invalid date/time formats return proper Bahasa Indonesia errors without 500; (3) Overnight shift SHIFT-M correctly calculates check_out_at on next day with POSITIVE work_minutes (420 minutes verified); (4) Non-overnight shift validation rejects check_out <= check_in; (5) Period lock blocks imports and reopen allows them; (6) Tenant isolation prevents cross-company data access; (7) Audit logs are created for all import actions with correct fields. Environment is healthy, all periods restored, and preview is ready for user testing. Import Attendance feature is PRODUCTION-READY with all edge cases tested.
